relations.definition: Performer of a specified song recording; disambiguate recording/cover/version when necessary.
Actor portraying a character in a specified work and version; not a voice actor unless explicitly separated.

relations.direction: character in specified work/version -> voice actor
relations.definition: Voice actor for the specified character and language/version.
Definition of an explicit term; allow equivalent paraphrases, retain scope and named sense.
Conventional term uniquely fitting a supplied defining description; distinct from the inverse term_to_definition.
Unique entity satisfying an explicitly qualified identifying description.
Full release date for a disambiguated work/version and market; do not conflate release year, birth date or duration.
Release year, kept separate from full date.
Named author of a disambiguated written work; retain multi-author constraints.
Specified filming site or country at the granularity asked; not setting of the story.
Episode count with season/version/time cutoff stated where necessary.
Stable class membership at a stated taxonomy level; not an arbitrary attribute.
Geographic containment at a specified level; not habitat, origin, or process location.
Typical or natural habitat, retaining scope and range rather than asserting exclusivity.
Material composition of a specified entity; distinguish constituent, whole and production source.
Stated part-whole membership; not the inverse whole_to_part.
Specified constituent of a whole; account for multiple valid parts.
Meaning of a symbol in its explicit domain/context.
Expansion of an abbreviation in the stated domain, not a loose association.
An actually equivalent name, keeping definition and descriptive property separate.
